Specification: This module specifies a very small two-variable transition system over integers. The initial state sets x to 0 and y to 1, and each Next step updates x from the current value of y and updates y from the current value of x, using conditional assignments that cap the next value at 10 once the source variable exceeds 5. The specification focuses on temporal formulas with multiple nested diamond operators, explicitly testing behavior when superfluous eventuality operators are present; it includes one liveness property asserting eventual reachability of x > 2 and another false liveness property asserting eventual reachability of x = 11.
